children: ”) (TSX-V: ORC.A, ORC.B) is issuing a correction to its news release titled “Orca Announces Quarterly Dividend” dated August 12, 2026 (the “

”). The Q3 Quarterly Dividend Release stated the dividend would be payable to shareholders of record on September 30, 2026. As September 30, 2026 is a public holiday in Canada, the record date has been corrected to September 29, 2026. All other information contained in the Q3 Quarterly Dividend Release remains unchanged.

Orca is an international public company engaged in natural gas exploration, development and supply in Tanzania through its subsidiary PanAfrican Energy Tanzania Limited. Orca trades on the TSX Venture Exchange under the trading symbols ORC.A and ORC.B.

Neither the TSX Venture Exchange nor its Regulation Service Provider (as that term is defined in the policies of the TSX Venture Exchange) accepts responsibility for the adequacy or accuracy of this release.
